summary:
Implementation plan updated with all 6 mandatory user corrections:
1. Physical serving count inventory decrements (decoupling chemical strength like 60,000 IU or 1,500 mg from physical capsule count).
2. Schedule- and frequency-aware refill formulas (weekly intake and cyclic protocol math).
3. Explicit 'Take All [Slot]' batch action headers with consolidated undo toasts.
4. Dynamic hiding of unpopulated/empty time slots on rest days.
5. 2-second debounce on Google Drive cloud sync to avoid HTTP 429 rate limits.
6. Resolution of App.tsx state, memoized profile maps, and handlers for clean zero-error compilation.
